about: Fresh-estate trials (#3803, #3805): the first-try proof rate on estates the system has never seen. Generated page: docs/language_status/fresh_estate_trials.md + .svg (tests/tools/trial.py report --write). `estates`: id, kind public (repo + ref) or private (an anonymised `label` only: no repo, ref or path), status fresh | development. A development estate is one the system was built or tuned against -- CardDemo, CBSA, zopeneditor, GENAPP, zECS, DSF -- or one that has been through a trial (`trialled_by`): it never counts as first-try again. `trials`: one per estate, started by `trial.py start` only. `system` is the frozen system: engine commit + version (last tag), the porting-rules hash (sha256 of PORTING_RULES + the ticket version), model + model_version + backend, and the harness commit (the last commit touching tests/tools/equivalence*.py or its image). `eligible` (the programs the equivalence harness can run: trial.py ELIGIBILITY_RULES) and `out_of_scope` ({program: reason}) are declared at start and fingerprinted in `declared`; neither may change afterwards. `programs`: per eligible program, `attempts` [{n, outcome proven|failed|no-port|error, cause model|ticket|generator|engine|harness|null, fix_commit, at, model}] imported from the porting loop's port_log.jsonl by `trial.py sync` -- a cause on our side is a commit carrying `Trial-Cause: <cause> <PROGRAM>`, a retry with no such commit is the model's -- and `final`: proven@N(causes of the failures before it) | not-proven(cause) (set by `trial.py close`) | open. Do not edit by hand.
